program_name: PM-KUSUM Solar Pump Technician & Modern Agri Scheme
skills: Solar Water Pump & Agri Machinery Operation
benefits: 90% government subsidy on solar agri pumps, free 5-day solar pump maintenance training, ₹500/day stipend allowance.
application_process: Voice register via SkillSaathi -> Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) document check.
source: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare / MNRE

program_name: ICAR Organic Farming & Drip Irrigation Certification
benefits: Free soil health testing kit, organic certification license, ₹10,000 bio-fertilizer voucher, micro-irrigation subsidy linkage.
application_process: Submit profile -> District Agriculture Officer (DAO) approval.

program_name: PMKVY 4.0 Advanced Electrician & Solar PV Technician
benefits: Free government certification under Skill India, ₹8,000 tool-kit incentive, 3-month stipend allowance, and direct job placement support.
application_process: 1-click auto application submit via SkillSaathi -> Aadhaar verification at nearest PMKVY Training Centre -> Assessment.
source: National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) - PMKVY 4.0 Guidelines

program_name: Karnataka Skill Mission - Chief Minister Koushalya Yojna (CMKY) Electrical Specialist
benefits: State certification, ₹1,500 monthly stipend during 60-day residential upgrading module, free safety gear kit, and micro-loan linkage.
application_process: Submit profile via SkillSaathi -> Verification by District Skill Development Officer (DSDO) -> Course commencement.
source: Karnataka Skill Development Corporation (KSDC) Official Portal
